what: The two-line sentence in the header’s center cell is pushed up 83px and out of the cell when the top edge of a designated section (list · feed) reaches the top of the screen, and the small logo waiting 83px below rises into place (.6s cubic-bezier(.12,.78,.32,.98)). Scrolling back above that section reverses it and the sentence drops back in — the company About sentence on the Hero, the logo while reading the list

options.[data-fx-part=phrase] · [data-fx-part=lo: Crest / logo (two children) — overlap in a single cell
options.target: Section that turns into a logo when its top edge touches (selector). If empty, always the sentence
options.at: Distance (px) from the top of the screen that counts as touched, default 0
options.state: If logo, always shows the logo regardless of scroll (subpage header)
options.--fx-pitch: Vertical distance between sentence and logo (via style), default 83px — must be larger than the cell height so the pushed side is clipped out of view
options.--fx-dur · --fx-ease: Duration and curve (via style), default .6s cubic-bezier(.12,.78,.32,.98)

use:
